tools.name: stage_image
tools.title: Save an image for a card
tools.description: Save an image file, a PDF figure or part of a PDF page for a card and return its tag. The image goes into the user's images folder; Anki gets a copy with draft_commit. Look at the returned thumbnail.

source.description: Image or PDF on the user's computer (absolute path), or an image URL
source.title: Source

figure.description: PDF: figure id from pdf_figures, e.g. 'p3f1'
figure.title: Figure

page.description: PDF: page number, when no figure is given
page.title: Page

region.description: Part to cut out: [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions (0-1) of the page or image
region.title: Region

tools.name: pdf_figures
tools.title: Find figures in a PDF
tools.description: List the figures (diagrams, photos, plots) on PDF pages with their ids, regions and captions.

path.description: PDF on the user's computer (absolute path)
path.title: Path

pages.description: Pages to search, e.g. '3' or '2-5,8' (at most 20)
pages.title: Pages

show_page.description: Also return the first page as a picture, with the figures boxed and a 10% grid
show_page.title: Show Page

tools.name: render_graph
tools.title: Draw a graph
tools.description: Draw a graph, tree or automaton with Graphviz and return its tag for a card field. The image goes into the user's images folder. Node labels can be hidden later with draft_add_occlusion.

dot.description: Graphviz DOT source, e.g. 'digraph { A -> B }'
dot.title: Dot

tools.name: overview
tools.title: Decks and note types
tools.description: The decks with their card counts and the note types with their exact field names. Call it before drafting.

deck.description: Only this deck and its subdecks
deck.title: Deck

tools.name: search_notes
tools.title: Search notes
tools.description: Find notes with Anki's search syntax. One line per note, newest first.

tools.name: update_notes
tools.title: Update notes
tools.description:
Change fields of existing notes. Keeps the review history, so prefer it over deleting and re-adding.

Notes not created by this plugin need force=true: ask the user first. Returns a batch id for undo.

fields.description: Only the fields that change, with their full new content
fields.title: Fields

force.description: Needed for notes the user wrote. Ask the user first
force.title: Force

tools.name: delete_notes
tools.title: Delete notes
tools.description:
Delete notes created by this plugin, with their review history. This cannot be undone.

Only for cards that should not exist at all; fix wrong cards with update_notes instead.

tools.name: undo
tools.title: Undo a batch
tools.description:
Revert a draft_commit or update_notes by its batch id: added notes are deleted, changed fields restored.

A note the user edited since is left alone.

tools.name: sync
tools.title: Sync with AnkiWeb
tools.description: Sync the collection with AnkiWeb, so new cards reach the user's phone and reviews from the phone count.

tools.name: draft_add
tools.title: Add cards to a draft
tools.description:
Check cards against Anki and add them to a draft. Nothing is written to Anki.

Returns the cards as text to show the user. If any card has a problem, none is added and every problem is listed.

fields.description: Field name -> content (HTML), names exactly as overview lists them
fields.title: Fields

note_type.description: Only if it differs from the draft's note type
note_type.title: Note Type

deck.description: Only if it differs from the draft's deck
deck.title: Deck

draft_id.description: Add to this draft. Without it a new draft is created
draft_id.title: Draft Id

deck.description: New draft: full deck name, e.g. 'Math::Analysis'
deck.title: Deck

tags.description: New draft: tags for all its cards
tags.title: Tags

allow_duplicate.description: Allow cards whose first field already exists
allow_duplicate.title: Allow Duplicate

tools.name: draft_add_occlusion
tools.title: Add an image occlusion card to a draft
tools.description:
Add an Image Occlusion note (Anki 23.10+) to a draft. Each mask, or each group of masks, becomes one card.

Returns the image with the masks drawn in. Check that every mask covers exactly its label.

image.description: Image file name from stage_image or render_graph, e.g. 'heart.png'
image.title: Image

label.description: Text on the image (a PDF word or a graph node) to hide
label.title: Label

region.description: Area to hide instead of a label: [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions (0-1) of the image
region.title: Region

group.description: Masks with the same group are asked together on one card
group.title: Group

header.description: Shown above the image, e.g. what to name
header.title: Header

back_extra.description: Shown below the image on the back
back_extra.title: Back Extra

hide_all.description: True: all masks hidden, one asked. False: only the asked mask hidden
hide_all.title: Hide All

draft_id.description: Add to this draft. Without it a new draft is created
draft_id.title: Draft Id

tags.description: New draft: tags for all its cards
tags.title: Tags

tools.name: draft_edit
tools.title: Change cards in a draft
tools.description:
Change or remove cards of a draft by number. Send only the fields that change; the others stay.

Returns the changed cards as text to show the user.

card.description: Card number in the draft, e.g. 3 for #3
card.title: Card

remove.description: Remove the card from the draft
remove.title: Remove

tools.name: draft_show
tools.title: Show a draft
tools.description: Show the cards of a draft as text, or list the open drafts. Drafts survive restarts.

draft_id.description: Without it: list the open drafts
draft_id.title: Draft Id

tools.name: draft_commit
tools.title: Add draft cards to Anki
tools.description:
Add the cards the user approved to Anki. Missing decks are created. Returns a batch id for undo.

Cards that fail stay in the draft with the reason. The draft is deleted when no cards are left.

cards.description: Only these card numbers. Without it: all cards
cards.title: Cards

tools.name: stats
tools.title: Study statistics
tools.description:
How the collection is doing, and the notes the user struggles with most.

Health: card counts, reviews per day, true retention.
Weak notes: ranked by again rate, lapses and FSRS difficulty, with flags that hint at the cause.

scope.description: Anki search that limits the cards, e.g. 'deck:GAD'
scope.title: Scope

weak_limit.description: How many weak notes to list; 0 for none
weak_limit.title: Weak Limit

tools.name: youtube_transcript
tools.title: YouTube transcript
tools.description:
Read the transcript of a YouTube video.

A long video returns a timestamped outline instead; call again with 'intervals' to read the parts that matter.
